title: Why MCP and ChatGPT Apps Use Double Iframes — Frédéric Barthelet, Alpic
talk_summary: A deep dive into why ChatGPT/MCP apps render third-party UI inside a double iframe: the outer iframe provides origin isolation and a per-app subdomain for storage/cookie separation, while the inner srcdoc iframe carries the app content with a CSP declared via metadata. The speaker demos a CSP inspector that diffs declared domains against actually-called domains to catch missing CSP entries before app-store submission.

takeaways.what_they_do: A dev tool watches network calls made by the rendered view and compares them against the domains declared in the app's metadata, flagging any undeclared domain as missing so it can be fixed before production.
takeaways.evidence_quote: looks at all the domains that you listed inside your metadata and all the domains that are actually accessed by calls made by your view and compare them

takeaways.what_they_do: Skybridge ships a local dev inspector that lists exposed tools, lets you execute any tool, renders its view live, and surfaces config errors (CSP) before deploying to the host.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a small app that will give me inspection tooling to work with my app before I bring it to chat GPT
